description: Enjoy with family this fabulous place to stay that offers good times in perspective, you will appreciate the location near the RER B to move quickly to PARIS airports and all destinations. 3 bedrooms with double beds and one bedroom with 2 single beds. The kitchen and its veranda will allow you to have your meals with your family and for your evening the spacious living room will be ideal.
